emails.contact_verified_at: https://www.commbuys.com/bso/ (help desk address printed on the portal home page)
emails.why_asking: 923 open bids (2026-10-08), ~35-50% facilities: state agencies plus hundreds of towns, school districts and housing authorities. No API/RSS; portal has no terms link and mass.gov policy page 403s to our crawler, so asking first.
emails.subject: Free extra distribution for facilities notices on COMMBUYS
emails.body:
Hello COMMBUYS team,

PMRFP (pmrfp.com) is a free board where commercial roofing, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, janitorial, landscaping, snow and general contractors in Canada and the U.S. look for building and maintenance work.

We'd like to list the facilities and construction notices posted on COMMBUYS — Commonwealth agencies, cities, towns, school districts and housing authorities — on PMRFP, at no cost to you, the posting agencies or bidders, so they reach more local contractors.

What we would show: the notice title, a short summary, closing date, the buyer contact and a link back to the official posting on COMMBUYS. Your portal stays the official source. We don't copy documents, bidders register and submit through your system as usual, and we update or remove any listing on request. We would read the public list once a day, politely, identified as "PMRFP tender indexer".

If that's acceptable, a reply saying so is enough. If you'd prefer, you can point us to a feed or export you're happy for us to use instead.

Thank you,

R. Talkar
PMRFP · pmrfp.com · info@pmrfp.com
Talkerstein Consulting Group, 5050 Dufferin St., Toronto, ON M3H 5T5
If you'd rather not hear from us again, reply "unsubscribe".
